p1: At 2 a.m., my flatmate Josh texted me: Don't turn on the lights when you get home.
Weird. Josh hates his phone. He leaves it on the couch every night.
I thought it was a prank. I left the lights off anyway.
In the dark hallway, I heard breathing. From the lounge room.
In bed, I texted him: was that you? He replied instantly.
Go to sleep. I'll be right here.
Next morning, Josh came out yawning. I showed him the texts.
I didn't text you, mate. I was asleep.
His phone was on the couch. The cushion next to it was pressed down... still warm.
Last night at 2 a.m., Josh's phone texted me again.
Don't turn on the light. I'm in your room now.
I'm still under the covers. I haven't looked.
